discription: A simple bell-like sound created with two slightly detuned sine waves and a decaying envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=1.007, attack=0.01, decay=2.0;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.perc(attack, decay, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var sine1 = SinOsc.ar(freq);    var sine2 = SinOsc.ar(freq * detune);    sig = (sine1 + sine2) * 0.5 * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
